intro: Add Ocean Flow to your phone's home screen and open it like any other app, without going through the browser every time.

ios.title: iPhone / iPad (Safari)
ios.step1: Open Ocean Flow in Safari — it has to be Safari, this doesn't work from other browsers on iOS.
ios.step2: Tap the Share icon in the bottom bar.
ios.step3: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
ios.step4: Tap "Add" in the top right — done.

android.title: Android (Chrome)
android.step2: Tap the menu (⋮) in the top right.
android.step3: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen".

note: The icon will appear alongside your other apps. It doesn't take up any more space than any other one.
